waves.name: Master file reader
waves.rationale: READJOB runs PGMR, which opens SPARQ.TEST.MASTER for input only and writes nothing another entry point uses. It proves the toolchain and the comparison harness on the smaller risk. The reader keeps consuming the file the legacy writer still produces, so it can be deployed and rolled back on its own.
waves.unblocks: The record layout in LAYOUTX, which wave 2 shares, and the first decoded packed-decimal comparison.

waves.name: Master file writer
waves.rationale: WRITEJOB runs PGMW, which creates SPARQ.TEST.MASTER, the dataset PGMR reads. The byte layout of that file is the contract that wave 1 already depends on, so this wave carries the cutover risk. It goes after the reader because the new reader can be proven against legacy output first.
waves.unblocks: Retiring the legacy producer of the master file. Nothing else in the tree depends on this wave.
